service_base_url.description: Configured HTTPS key-custody API base URL; embedded credentials, queries, and fragments are refused by the adapter.

tenant_id.description: Tenant identifier returned during custody enrollment.

custody_key_id.description: Active custody key created through the customer management API. It identifies a wrapping key only; it is not a credential.

client_signing_secret.description: Base64 Ed25519 private key emitted once during client enrollment.

tls_spki_pin.description: Optional SHA-256 SPKI pin for the custody HTTPS certificate. Leave unset for normal CA validation; update through a tested endpoint-identity migration before a certificate-key rotation.
